c: p:my little pony friendship is magic
d:
Twitter (sxshely + BUNNIIYE + ANGHELIKOL) + Instagram + kemono.cr + not paywalled Patreon images + a few images I found on Internet Archive + some images I had saved from Youtube community page and I couldn't find anywhere else.

I also included the mp4 animations, but the sound is lost in conversion from mp4 to webp. Many videos had sound in them, but some didn't. For the smaller files I did lossless conversion, but for the larger ones it's lossy. I tried to remove duplicates as best as I could. There are no animations from Youtube, just from the sources listed above. Just be careful trying to open the largest webp files, you may need a lot of RAM. The animation is at the end of the gallery sorted by size, so that the largest files are at the very end. The 6 first webp files at the end with "gif" in their names are gifs losslessly converted to webp to reduce size.
